## The general term {#ss3-general-term .ap-lesson .ap-formula-sheet}

Starting at term $1$, reaching term $n$ takes $n-1$ additions of $d$.

::: {.split .ap-formula-layout}
::: {.column-block}
::: {.takeaway .fragment data-fragment-index="0"}
$$a_n=\textcolor{#3b66a8}{a}+(n-1)\textcolor{#b55224}{d}\qquad(n\ge1)$$

:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="1"}
$$n=1:\quad a_1=a+0d=a$$

$$n=4:\quad a_4=a+3d$$

:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="2"}
For an infinite sequence, $n\in\{1,2,3,\ldots\}$.

For a finite sequence, stop at its final index.

:::

:::
::: {.column-block .ap-reference-excerpt .fragment data-fragment-index="0"}
